description: This file defines the DefaultValueBinder class, which implements the logic for binding various data types to spreadsheet cells within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles sanitization, type detection, and conversion of input values before setting them in spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: DefaultValueBinder
classes.description: Implements data binding logic for spreadsheet cell values, determining proper data types and handling value sanitization and conversion.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Binds a given value to a specified cell, performing sanitization and type setting.

methods.name: dataTypeForValue
methods.description: Determines the appropriate data type for a given value for spreadsheet representation.
